name: New Hartford Barber Company
lead: After a 2021 fire took the original shop, owner Alanna Sartirana vowed to reopen, and saved the barber pole. Today New Hartford Barber Co. has a perfect 5.0 from 23 Google reviews.

about: New Hartford Barber Co. is owned by Alanna Sartirana.
In August 2021 a fire destroyed the original shop in the historic New Hartford House in the center of town. Sartirana vowed to reopen and saved the barber pole from the building's exterior.
Customers have given the shop a perfect 5.0 across 23 Google reviews.
